bugs.name: adder_pipe_bitwidth
bugs.description: Pipelined adder output sum is declared 8 bits wide ([7:0]) instead of the required 9 bits ([8:0]) to hold the full a+b range (max 511). For inputs a=200, b=200 the correct sum is 400, but the 8-bit register wraps modulo 256 yielding 144. Widening sum to [8:0] (and the output port accordingly) eliminates the overflow.

bugs.name: adder_pipe_comb
bugs.description: 组合逻辑加/减法器, case(sel) 缺少 default 分支。sel=2/3 时综合出 latch, y 保持旧值而非归零。修复: 在 case 末尾补 default: y = 0;。

bugs.name: adder_pipe_syntax
bugs.description: Adder with illegal operator +* in expression. RTL fails to compile under iverilog (syntax error). Standard adder testbench detects sum==30.

bugs.name: counter_bitwidth
bugs.description: 8-bit counter has its count register declared as only 4 bits wide ([3:0]), so it wraps at 15 instead of counting up to 200 as an 8-bit counter should.

bugs.name: counter_reset
bugs.description: 8-bit counter reset value is wrong: synchronous reset assigns 0xFF instead of 0x00, so the counter starts at 255 instead of 0 after reset.

bugs.name: counter_syntax
bugs.description: counter 计数器语法 bug: 'always @(posedge clk)' 被错拼成 'alwayss @(posedge clk)'(多写一个 s), 导致 iverilog 编译失败。TB 本身是正确的标准计数器测试bench, 但因 rtl.v 存在语法错, iverilog rtl.v tb.v 整体编译失败(exit!=0, stderr 含 syntax error), 这就是该 syntax bug 的检测信号。

bugs.name: tiny_fsm_comb
bugs.description: Two-state FSM (S0/S1) with combinational next-state logic. The S0 branch unconditionally keeps next=S0 instead of in?S1:S0, so the FSM is permanently stuck in S0 and never transitions to S1 even when in=1. Output out (Moore, =state) stays 0.

bugs.name: tiny_fsm_reset
bugs.description: Two-state Moore FSM (S0/S1). Reset is wrongly asserted to S1 instead of S0; correct design resets state to S0 so output is 0 after reset. Healable=false because FSM reset-value bugs are hard to auto-repair reliably.
